name: Inverted Row
cues: Set the bar in the rack at about waist height
Hang under it with your body straight and heels on the floor
Pull your chest to the bar
Bend your knees to make it easier

The owner should also look at three things: the head passes behind an upright mid-rep, the top elbow is 141 deg, and the figure is small because the rack is framed whole. | skeptic: The movement is right.
